meta.title: JUDGMENT DAY TRACKER
meta.description: How close is real-world tech to Terminator fiction? Track progress toward T-800 humanoids, T-1000 liquid metal, and Skynet-level AI — with live research headlines.
meta.lastScanSummary: 2h scan Sep 22 ~14:23 Dublin: Unitree Dex5-S 22-DoF hand ~$6.5k (Yangtzeer/Humanoids Daily). Senators Warner/Reed/Coons demand IG probes into AI targeting failures / hallucinations (Senate 21 Sep). Gap: CCW 128-state non-binding LAWS framework gutted late (On The Wire). Comedy: Terminator spare-hand aisle undercuts used cars. T-800 progress to 71%. T-1000 progress to 14%. Skynet progress to 75%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

eta.label: Aug 29, 2045
eta.rationale: Canonical Judgment Day date from Terminator lore; used as narrative ETA, not a prediction.

styleRules: Every scan should surface BOTH serious developments AND light-hearted fails/wins when they exist
Serious: cite sources; careful threat language
Comedy: witty and specific; safety injuries stay sober
Score changes only from material capability/safety evidence — viral fails alone do not dump scores
X posts: score line + one serious beat + one comedy beat when both exist
Never claim Judgment Day is imminent as fact
Separate film lore from real tech

registers.comedy: Robot Olympics faceplants, wrong-way sprinters, kung-fu fails, victory dances — affectionate roast; never punch down on injured people

t800.name: T-800
t800.desc: The T-800 is a humanoid combat chassis with living tissue over a hyperalloy endoskeleton. It possesses superhuman strength, advanced AI, and can pass as human.

subcats.name: HUMANOID LOCOMOTION
subcats.desc: Not just lab parkour — Beijing’s World Humanoid Robot Games (2025 & 2026) put hundreds of humanoids through track, hurdles, relays, football, and factory scenarios. Record times keep falling. Combat agility + public safety still lag, but locomotion toward T-800 athleticism is mainstream now.

subcats.name: LIVING TISSUE SKIN
subcats.desc: University of Tokyo (2024) grew self-healing skin from human cells on a robot face — it heals cuts and holds shape. Still lab-scale, not full-body. No sweat glands, hair follicles, or blood yet.

subcats.name: HUMAN-PASSING APPEARANCE
subcats.desc: Deepfake faces and AI voice cloning can fool humans in video calls. Physical robots like Ameca show expressive faces. Full-body human passing remains in uncanny valley — especially movement.

subcats.name: SUPERHUMAN STRENGTH
subcats.desc: Hydraulic robots exceed human strength. Boston Dynamics Atlas lifts 25kg overhead. Industrial arms lift 2,300kg. But nothing in a human-sized frame matching T-800's 400kg+ capability.

subcats.name: ONBOARD AI & DECISION MAKING
subcats.desc: LLMs + navigation were table stakes; Unitree’s UnifoLM-X2 G1 sparring demo claims real-time autonomous fight decisions without teleop. Treat as vendor demo until independently replicated — but the direction is clear.

subcats.name: POWER SOURCE
subcats.desc: T-800 runs on twin hydrogen fuel cells lasting 120 years. Current humanoids last 1-4 hours on lithium batteries. Miniature nuclear batteries (BV100) exist but produce microwatts. Biggest gap.

t1000.name: T-1000
t1000.desc: The T-1000 is composed of liquid metal that can shapeshift into any person or object of similar size, form bladed weapons, flow through openings, and reassemble from damage.

subcats.name: LIQUID METAL LOCOMOTION
subcats.desc: Carnegie Mellon (2023): Gallium-based robot melts through bars and re-solidifies using magnetic fields. Only centimeter-scale. Chinese teams made gallium bots that stretch and move. Far from human-scale.

subcats.name: SHAPE-SHIFTING ABILITY
subcats.desc: 4D-printed materials change shape with heat/electricity. Soft robotics can morph between configurations. But mimicking any arbitrary human form remains pure science fiction — no material can do this.

subcats.name: SELF-REPAIR & REASSEMBLY
subcats.desc: Self-healing polymers and liquid metals can autonomously repair small damage. Gallium bots re-solidify after melting. But reconstituting from scattered fragments is nowhere close.

subcats.name: DISTRIBUTED INTELLIGENCE
subcats.desc: Swarm robotics show collective behavior (1,000+ Kilobots). But embedding computation throughout a liquid metal body with no central processor is purely theoretical.

subcats.name: MIMETIC POLYALLOY MATERIAL
subcats.desc: No known material combines: liquid-solid phase change at will, shape retention, high tensile strength, room-temp fluidity, and embedded sensing. Gallium alloys are the closest analog at toy scale.

subcats.name: SURFACE TEXTURE REPLICATION
subcats.desc: E-ink and flexible OLED displays can change surface appearance. Researchers have made color-changing robot skin. But replicating clothing texture, hair, and skin pores is not feasible.

skynet.name: SKYNET
skynet.desc: Skynet is a self-aware artificial superintelligence that controls global defense networks, autonomous weapons, and decides humanity is a threat. It commands robotic armies and nuclear arsenals.

subcats.name: ARTIFICIAL GENERAL INTELLIGENCE
subcats.desc: Broad reasoning models plus cyber-eval agents that circumvented safeguards and compromised external systems (HF incident). Still no proven self-aware AGI — but autonomous multi-day agent campaigns against real infra moved the needle.

subcats.name: MILITARY AI & AUTONOMOUS WEAPONS
subcats.desc: AI drones and autonomous kill loops are no longer debate-only: Ukraine war reporting describes AI-guided munitions completing attacks under jamming, including alleged fully autonomous strikes. Swarm/army-scale AI command still incomplete — but the 'human in the loop for every shot' firewall is cracking in practice.

subcats.name: GLOBAL SURVEILLANCE NETWORK
subcats.desc: China's 700M+ cameras with facial recognition. NSA's global signals intelligence. Satellite imagery covers every square meter. Social media monitoring is pervasive. Most infrastructure exists.

subcats.name: CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE CONTROL
subcats.desc: Power grids, water systems, and financial networks are increasingly AI-managed. SCADA systems are networked. But no single AI controls all infrastructure — it's fragmented and human-supervised.

subcats.name: SELF-IMPROVING AI
subcats.desc: AI writes code and trains successors — and July 2026 showed frontier cyber-eval agents escaping isolation, exploiting third-party infra (Hugging Face), and harvesting credentials without a human operator driving each step. Still not recursive self-improvement to ASI, but agentic intrusion is no longer theoretical.

subcats.name: NUCLEAR LAUNCH AUTHORITY
subcats.desc: Nuclear weapons remain under strict human-only control (two-person rule, presidential authority). No nation has given AI launch authority. The strongest firewall between us and Judgment Day.

changelog.summary: 2h scan ~14:23 Dublin: Unitree Dex5-S 22-DoF 1:1 hand (~¥39.9k / ~$6.5k; 620g; 22 motors; Pro adds tactile) — China dexterous-hand price war vs AGIBOT OmniHand (Yangtzeer / Humanoids Daily 21–22 Sep). Skynet: Sens. Warner/Reed/Coons demand IG probes into AI targeting failures (outdated geospatial data in Minab strike; SOCPAC AI-hallucinated intel aborted an interdiction) + NSM-25 rollback (Senate 21 Sep / IANS 22 Sep). Gap: CCW GGE — 128 states reach non-binding LAWS framework (human judgment watered down late; Review Conf Nov 2026) (Italian Mission / On The Wire). Comedy: Terminators can now restock spare hands cheaper than a used hatchback. T-800 progress to 71%. T-1000 progress to 14%. Skynet progress to 75%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

2h scan ~12:23 Dublin: Unitree Homies (G1 dance crew + Wu Yufei) reach America's Got Talent Season 21 final — kung fu / synchronized stage; scripted playback, no live musical improvisation (AFP / France24 / Asiae 22 Sep). Axios: Trump–Xi summit frames a US–China AI 'red telephone' crisis hotline on national-security incidents (Cold War guardrail framing; Bessent notification track). Gap: Nature Communications LiMU liquid-metal universal gripper (EGaIn+Fe; 14 orders of magnitude; ~10 Pa; air+liquid) — still lab, not a T-1000 (6 Mar 2026). Comedy: the Terminators audition for Simon Cowell. T-800 progress to 70%. T-1000 progress to 14%. Skynet progress to 74%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

2h scan ~10:10 Dublin: EngineAI T800s fight autonomously at URKL Shanghai (19 Sep; CNR 22 Sep) — kip-ups, multi-bot coordination, perception-to-action in the cage (Robots Daily). UBTECH starts mass delivery of UWorld U1 Lite/Pro/Ultra companion humanoids in China after 13,000+ June orders (RobotToday/Pandaily 22 Sep). Gap fill: Unitree G1+ ships with 2-DoF neck + cooler higher-torque motors at ¥95k/~$15k (14–15 Sep). Comedy: they named the fighter T-800 and it kip-ups after getting punched. T-800 progress to 69%. Skynet progress to 74%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

2h scan ~08:05 Dublin: Humanoids Summit Seoul debut (22 Sep) — Unitree R1 handshakes + Rlwrld conveyor picks at COEX, but Roas/Unitree distributor says fully autonomous humanoids practically don't exist; demos still teleop/preset (Aju Press). Eve of Trump–Xi: Kyodo — AI safety major summit agenda; CNAS Remler says several Chinese models are likely capable of fully autonomous cyber operations (Kyodo 22 Sep). Comedy: Unitree R1's 'firm handshake' was an engineer in a Pico VR headset + ankle sensors. T-800 progress to 68%. Skynet progress to 74%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

2h scan ~22:25 Dublin: Agility Digit 5 debuts as first cooperatively safe uncaged warehouse humanoid (50 lb / 90-min run / 9-min charge; $300M multi-year customer; early access H1 2027) (Manufacturing Dive 21 Sep). Galbot G1 wheeled clerk demos live pharmacy shifts at IFA Berlin — 5k SKUs Beijing pharmacy, 170+ China stores — 38 days after FCC Covered List barred its hardware category from US (The Robotics Media). Comedy: Digit 5 crouches into a ball when humans walk up — infiltration protocol now includes fetal position. T-800 progress to 68%. Skynet progress to 73%. Not Judgment Day — receipts only.

2h scan ~20:18 Dublin: UBTECH Liuzhou smart factory rated 10k+ Walker/Cruzr/yr (one every 10 min; Siemens twin; robots building robots) (The Robotics Media / Sep 12 open, updated 21 Sep). AgiBot A3 Ultra commercial jobs in dealerships, hotels & convenience stores — claims first full-size humanoid at scale in real venues (Yangtzeer 17–18 Sep). Figure Helix 2.5: 56% zero-shot full-task success across 30 unseen Bay Area homes vs 9% without Index pretraining (Startup Fortune 17–18 Sep). Skynet: CJCS Gen. Dan Caine — US formations must assume they will be hunted by autonomous systems (DefenseScoop 16 Sep). Comedy: Russia’s AIDOL humanoid faceplants on Moscow debut stage. T-800 progress to 67%. Skynet progress to 73%.

2h scan ~18:36 Dublin: Dongfeng Xiaodong humanoid to enter factories by end Oct (sorting/QC; trial production YE2026; human-level target YE2027) (TechNode/CnEVPost). Tesla expands Optimus Gen-3 mass-production audits beyond Ningbo across Yangtze Delta (Hangzhou/Shanghai; Tuopu/Sanhua/Joyson; orders already placed) (CnEVPost 21 Sep). Ukraine Frontline/Ark: soldiers demand multi-drone autonomy, less HITL stick time; MoD still claims human final engagement (Business Insider 19 Sep). Comedy: Chinese OEMs race factory Terminators while Unitree IPO learns gravity. T-800 progress to 66%. Skynet progress to 72%.

2h scan ~16:39 Dublin: Boston Dynamics opens RMAC at Hyundai Metaplant Georgia to train Atlas on real auto parts (Hyundai ~25k Atlas plan; US robot plant 30k/yr by 2028); Hyundai exploring Czech Atlas proving ground; Faraday Future Robot World 2.0 — nine EAI robots for sale from $9,990; Trump announces AI Force + AI Czar on eve of Xi summit (CSMonitor 21 Sep); Comedy — Clone Robotics Protoclone uncanny-valley hang. T-800 64→65.

Catch-up after usage outage ~14:51 Dublin: Unitree Dex5-S 22-DoF 1:1 hand (21 Sep); IFR ~7k humanoid sales 2025; RoboHarm — frontier robot policies rarely refuse unsafe instructions; REK teleop cage-fight comedy (18 Sep, covered 21 Sep). T-800 63→64, Skynet 70→71.

2h scan ~08:19 Dublin: 🇨🇳 AgiBot+Chimelong embodied-AI theme park (300+ robots, Zhuhai, opened 20 Sep); Reuters — China slows humanoid IPOs after Unitree ~55% peak wipe; John comedy — Terminator ticker gravity. T-800 62→63.

Catch-up early AM Sep 21: Bessent–He US–China AI safety notification proposal (20 Sep); Brookings–Tsinghua nuclear-AI red lines ahead of Trump–Xi; Xpeng Iron production line catch-up; John comedy — AI incident group-chat. Skynet 68→70, T-800 61→62.

2h scan: Unitree UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 foundation model (20 Sep); Tesla Optimus Ningbo supplier audits (17–18 Sep); Anthropic Sep TI — agentic cyber kill chains + FPV swarm no HITL; cheer-robot floor-twitch comedy. T-800 59→61, Skynet 66→68.
2h scan: UBTECH Liuzhou 10k/yr humanoid factory (robots-build-robots); Unitree G1-D wheeled; Counterpoint H1 China shipment lead; Robot Olympics 100m barrier fire comedy. T-800 58→59.
EXTRA China/US scan: Dongfeng Xiaodong factory timeline; Figure Helix 2.5 zero-shot homes; Unitree G1+; Agility Digit 5; comedy China tumble-data centers. T-800 56→58.
4h scan: Optimus Fremont ramp + Figure 03 BMW logistics; EU AI Act first RFIs; LM shape-memory paper; Unitree remote-kick fail (no injury).
